name: KOReader e-reader
description: Jailbroken Kindle, Kobo, and other e-readers running KOReader with the Tesserae plugin (dmellok/tesserae-koreader). The plugin pairs with a claim code, polls GET /api/v1/device/<id>/frame on the configured cadence, decodes the packed 16-level greyscale frame on the device, and sleeps between refreshes. The e-reader reports its own screen size at pairing, so one kind covers every model.

sleep_interval_s.label: Refresh interval
sleep_interval_s.help: How long the e-reader sleeps between frame fetches. Tesserae echoes it back on every status poll as next_poll_s. Shorter intervals cost battery on readers that sleep between refreshes; on readers kept awake they only cost a small request when nothing changed.
